events.title: Next Fest Day 5: New map
events.summary: New vector tiles mapWe heard your feedback: some of you love our hand-drawn map, while others find it visually confusing. To address both sides, I Spacewalker walked around Inkscape for a bit and delivered a periodic table. Oops, I meant tiles! It actually has deep meaning, that will be expalined in future riddles. Have fun with the new map! BugfixesFixed the ability bar overlapping the How to Play panel.Fixed a loading bug that could prevent the map from progressing correctly.ChangesAdditional
